Azurill

Normal Fairy

Hoenn · Generation 3 · Baby Pokémon

Azurill is a Normal/Fairy-type Polka Dot Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 2 kg. It evolves into Marill. Its highest base stat is HP (50), with a base stat total of 190.
